purpose: First character and naming concepts for review

prompts.wenwen: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original cute pixel-art mascot for a philosophy learning website, character named 问问 (Wenwen), a thoughtful small capybara. This is a character concept asset for review, not a website screenshot. One complete full-body capybara only, standing in a calm curious three-quarter pose, warm taupe and oatmeal fur, distinct broad rounded muzzle, tiny rounded ears, shiny dark expressive eyes looking gently upward with a slight questioning eyebrow. Soft moss-green short waistcoat, holding a small open midnight-blue notebook with blank pages in its front paws. Friendly, attentive, willing to ask why rather than a pompous academic. Recognizable silhouette, large head and compact body, carefully authored charming 32-bit game pixel-art aesthetic, crisp intentional square pixel clusters, limited harmonious palette, stepped contours, subtle pixel shading, no smooth vector outlines, no photorealism, no 3D glossy render. Transparent background, generous clear margin around entire character including feet, centered composition, no cut off parts. No typography, no lettering, no watermarks, no background scene, no extra characters. This must be a distinct original mascot and must not be a yellow chick or resemble JOJO's existing bird mascot.
prompts.aying: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original cute pixel-art mascot for a self-media and video-making learning website, character named 阿映 (Aying), a small energetic raccoon storyteller. This is a character concept asset for review, not a website screenshot. One complete full-body raccoon only, standing in a lively but relaxed three-quarter pose, cool slate-gray fur, recognizable deep charcoal eye mask, cream cheeks, large curious glossy eyes, clearly visible gray-and-dark striped fluffy tail. A small warm apricot-orange knit beanie and a simple teal cross-body strap with a tiny blank shooting notebook. Holding a modest dark little film clapperboard with three cream diagonal marks and no writing, other paw gesturing invitingly as if asking a good interview question. Clever, warm, observant, practical, never smug. Recognizable silhouette, large head and compact body, carefully authored charming 32-bit game pixel-art aesthetic, crisp intentional square pixel clusters, limited harmonious palette, stepped contours, subtle pixel shading, no smooth vector outlines, no photorealism, no 3D glossy render. Transparent background, generous clear margin around all body parts including tail and feet, centered composition, no cropped parts. No typography, no lettering, no watermarks, no background scene, no extra characters. Distinct original mascot, not a yellow chick, clearly not the capybara mascot and not JOJO.
